profile.name: Mohammed Javad E
profile.summary: Software Developer based in Kochi, India — building fast, expressive web products end-to-end from database schema to polished UI.
intro: I started programming in higher secondary school with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, then built a foundation in C/C++ and core OOP concepts in Java before committing to software development.

That path led through a MERN stack apprenticeship at Devxtra into a software developer role at Bytsolv, where I've gone from learning fundamentals to independently shipping production applications. I enjoy building end-to-end — from database schema to polished UI — and I'm currently expanding into AI-assisted developer tooling and mobile development with React Native.

experiences.description: Independently designed and built roughly 90% of Papr.work v1 — a financial paperwork tracking product for early-stage startups — taking a product concept from database schema and system architecture through to a shipped, live application with React 19, TanStack Router/Query, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Hono, Drizzle ORM, and PostgreSQL. Also contributed full-stack features to SmileOS, a SaaS platform for dental clinics used by 5,000+ practices across Australia, and remain.fit.

projects.name: Papr

projects.name: SmileOS
projects.description: Complete growth operating system for dental clinics used by 5,000+ practices across Australia — automated patient communications, AI-driven enquiry actions, marketing pipelines, and practice analytics.

projects.name: remain.fit
projects.description: Small, single-purpose tools for the hard part of fitness — fasting, weight, streaks, and hydration with one account and a quiet design language.

experiences.description: Completed a structured 8-month MERN stack apprenticeship and creative web engineering role with weekly mentor reviews under experienced industry engineers. Built and shipped Hayon, a full-stack social media planning and analytics dashboard, on AWS EC2/S3.

contributions.title: Better CI for cross-compiling
contributions.description: Expanded CI coverage for cross-compilation jobs that cannot run target binaries. These jobs now compile all Cargo test targets instead of only the default test set, catching more target-specific build failures during CI.
